cwe_content.cwe: CWE-611,Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

candidate.Reason: XML parsing without disabling external entity processing, allowing XXE attacks. DocumentBuilderFactory is instantiated without setting features to restrict external entity references (FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING, setExpandEntityReferences(false), setFeature("http://xml.org/sax/features/external-general-entities", false), setFeature("http://xml.org/sax/features/external-parameter-entities", false))

DocumentBuilderFactory instantiation without secure configuration. While this method only creates new documents, the factory instance could potentially be reused for parsing without proper security settings, leading to XXE vulnerabilities
